lead: For people who add SYLY to a website. Learners never need to sign in.
why: You sign in with your Google account. We ask only for your Google account id, e-mail address and name (openid, email, profile). We keep them to show your sites. See Privacy.
btnHelp: The next control is Google's own button. If you cannot reach it with the keyboard or your screen reader, use the button after it, which opens Google's quick sign-in prompt instead.
promptHelp: If nothing appears, your browser may have hidden the prompt. Reload the page and try again.
after: After you sign in you go to your dashboard.
notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this server. Every other page works. The team lead can set it up: see Google sign-in setup in the README.
checking: Checking whether you are already signed in…
gisFail: Google's sign-in could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
